test_accounting: Full core library and 18 integration targets, plus three CLI integration targets. Earlier overlapping development/parser selections and publication-ledger checks are excluded. The native full-library run retains three pre-existing ignored tests. Optimized WASM counts 34 passing tests in the second interrupted run plus 38 passing tests in the remaining-target retry; overlapping initial/isolation runs are excluded. Both interrupted commands failed at the native runner and are recorded separately, not classified as successful full runs. No selected integration or WASM test is ignored.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of committed Git blob bytes
implementation: Analysis and temperature plans share retained lexical scope environments, declaration ownership, inherited snapshots and isolated groups of seeded random streams. Only demanded scope ancestry is retained after ENDS.

The parameter graph resolver reports an incomplete declaration scope before evaluating it, including indirect local-to-parent dependencies. A child override cannot rebind a retained parent expression. Already captured numeric/complex values and user functions remain snapshots.

Deferred options retry at ancestor completion in scope-close order. Entire option groups probe isolated streams before live sampling, cache materialization or publication; failed or cancelled probes retain no live draws. Ready local scopes keep their previous sampling phase.

Successfully resolved dependencies materialize in their owning active or retained context, sharing statistical samples across delayed child options, parent/root options and later analysis bindings. Authored assignment ordinals preserve the last option while still validating superseded assignments.
Bounded physical-temperature replay, cancellation and included-card error locations use existing parser boundaries. No public API or hierarchy instance-body representation changes.
acceptance_evidence: Nine new public regressions run in both expression dialects where applicable, including declarations after child/parent closure, unresolved header defaults, signed bare values, parent cycles repaired by later definitions and child overrides.

An initially resolvable parent graph changes from 80 to 85 after child closure; the deferred option observes the completed owner. Captured functions/complex values and unused lazy branches preserve their card-time meaning.
Independent seeded draw sequences check no probe draws, unchanged local scope phases, one-time owner sampling, sibling isolation and shared values across options and AC operands.
A 1 mA source and a resistor with R=TEMP produce 0.085 V after the delayed parent option selects 85 Celsius; an earlier TEMP parameter also becomes 85 after bounded replay.
Superseded undefined, cyclic and below-absolute-zero assignments remain errors. Sealed included sources and continuations preserve child.inc:3 on native and optimized WASM.

Private scope-transaction checks verify incomplete, failed and cancelled attempts publish neither option nor parameter cache and consume no live random samples. Existing root/global/source/analysis/control/temperature tests remain active.
limits: Ngspice expressions invalid only at the provisional temperature, such as 1/(TEMP-27), can still fail before replay. This remains a separate explicit implementation task.
General statistical/runtime binding, temperature-dependent sampling, derived-context policy, allocation/performance bounds and cancellation within classification remain open.
Passing the selected native/WASM execution and strict Clippy does not qualify every feature/profile/reference workload or close a C00-C14 package.

CLI runtime tests use installed Rust 1.95 because the earlier pinned Rust 1.94/faer compiler incident remains unresolved. The prior Rust 1.95 expected-relocatable-expression incident also remains C14 work; this batch does not claim to fix compiler reproducibility.

Two multi-target WASM commands failed inside the Windows native test runner before different target launches. Every selected core WASM test subsequently passed across the recorded partial/retry runs, but repeatable harness execution remains unqualified. Windows reported the same 0x3a30e2 fault offset inside wasm-bindgen-test-runner.exe for both crashes; this identifies the faulting module, not a proven root cause.
